description: This file implements functions related to managing resolve undo information in a version control system, possibly Git. It provides functionality to record, read, write, clear, and manipulate undo information associated with index entries, including handling merge conflicts and partial resolutions.

methods.name: void record_resolve_undo(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Records resolve undo information for a specific index entry, storing its mode and object id based on stage.

methods.name: void resolve_undo_write(struct strbuf * sb,struct string_list * resolve_undo,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Serializes resolve undo information into a buffer for storage or transmission.

methods.name: struct:string_list * resolve_undo_read(const char * data,unsigned long size,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Deserializes resolve undo data from a buffer into the program's internal data structures, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: void resolve_undo_clear_index(struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Clears the resolve undo data associated with an index, freeing memory and updating index status.

methods.name: int unmerge_index_entry(struct index_state * istate,const char * path,struct resolve_undo_info * ru,unsigned ce_flags)
methods.description: Removes an index entry and replaces it with multiple unmerged entries based on resolve undo info.

methods.name: void unmerge_index(struct index_state * istate,const struct pathspec * pathspec,unsigned ce_flags)
methods.description: Applies unmerge operations to multiple index entries based on resolve undo data and pathspec filtering.
